answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, rewards vest against future work. The kernel holds work receipts rather than names, so the prism of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The inlet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
